Lift out the lamb, stir the drained beans, sliced peppers and olives into the pan, put the lamb back on top and roast uncovered for 1 1/2 hours more.
Shred the lamb with two forks and stir the parsley into the beans before serving.

title: Spiced smoky barbecued chicken
steps: Mash the garlic with a little salt, then mix in the lemon zest and juice, the curry powder, pepper flakes, oil and plenty of black pepper.
Toss the chicken in the marinade while the barbecue heats.

Lay the herb bunches on the hot grill and put the chicken on top, skin side up. Close the lid and cook for about 10 minutes, then turn and cook for 20 to 30 minutes more, until charred and cooked through.
Without a barbecue, roast the chicken on the herbs in a 400°F (200°C) oven for 35 to 40 minutes.

title: Spicy Arrabiata Penne
steps: Cook the pasta in a large pot of salted boiling water as the package says, about 9 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, pepper flakes, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in the chopped basil.
Drain the pasta and toss it in the sauce. Serve warm with parmesan and more basil.

title: Spicy North African Potato Salad
steps: Put the potatoes in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil and cook for about 20 minutes, until a knife goes straight through.
Whisk the harissa, oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Drain the potatoes, cut them in half and stir in the harissa dressing and the sliced green onions.
Spread the arugula in a large salad bowl, add the potatoes and toss. Top with the crumbled feta, mint and pine nuts and season.

title: Spinach & Ricotta Cannelloni
steps: For the tomato sauce, heat the oil in a large pan and fry the garlic for 1 minute. Add the sugar, vinegar, tomatoes and seasoning and simmer for 20 minutes, until thick. Stir in the basil and spread it in 2 shallow baking dishes.
Beat the mascarpone with the milk until smooth and season.
Wilt the spinach by pouring boiling water over it in a colander, in batches. When cool, squeeze it dry and chop it. Mix it with 100 g of the parmesan, the ricotta, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pipe the filling into the cannelloni tubes with a bag and lay them side by side on the tomato sauce.
Spoon the mascarpone sauce over them and top with the rest of the parmesan and the torn mozzarella.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until golden and bubbling, and let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Spring onion and prawn empanadas
steps: For the dough, rub the butter into the flour, then add the egg white and half of the yolk (keep the rest), the vinegar, a pinch of salt and enough cold water to make a soft dough. Knead until smooth, wrap and rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Slice the green onions and fry them gently in a little oil until soft. Add the chopped chili and garlic, then the shrimp, and cook until they're opaque. Season.
Lift out the shrimp, boil the juices until they thicken and put the shrimp back.
Divide the dough into 8 balls and roll each into a thin circle. Put some filling on one half, sprinkle with feta, fold over and crimp the edges to seal.
Put them on an oiled baking sheet, brush with the rest of the yolk mixed with a splash of water and bake for about 30 minutes, until golden.

title: Squash linguine
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Put the cubed squash and the garlic on a baking sheet, drizzle with the oil and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, until soft. Season.
Cook the pasta as the package says. Drain it, keeping the water.
Blend the squash and garlic with about 1 2/3 cups (400 ml) of the pasta water into a sauce.
Fry the sage leaves in a little oil until crisp and drain them.
Tip the pasta and sauce into the pan and warm through. Scatter with the sage.

title: Squid, chickpea & chorizo salad
steps: Broil or grill the whole peppers until charred all over. Cover them in a bowl until cool, then peel, seed and slice them.
Mix the peppers and their juices with the drained chickpeas, chopped parsley, chili and garlic.
Heat a large frying pan until smoking. Add a splash of the oil and the sliced squid and stir-fry for 30 seconds. Scatter in the diced chorizo and cook for 30 seconds more.
Tip it into the bowl, season, dress with the rest of the oil and the lemon juice and zest, and mix. Serve on a platter.

title: Stamppot
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into even pieces and boil them with the bay leaves in salted water for 20 minutes. Remove the bay leaves.
Wash the kale, remove the tough stems and cut it into thin strips. Chop the shallots.
Melt 1 tbsp of the butter in a frying pan and cook the shallots for a few minutes. Add the kale and 2 tbsp of water, season and cook for about 10 minutes, until tender. Meanwhile, heat the sausages.
Warm the milk. Drain the potatoes, dry them and mash them with the warm milk and the rest of the butter. Season with nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Mix the kale into the mash and serve topped with slices of the sausage, with mustard or gravy.

title: Sticky Chicken
steps: Cut 3 slashes in each drumstick.
Mix the soy sauce, honey, oil, tomato paste and mustard, pour it over the chicken and coat well. Marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature, or overnight in the fridge.
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Tip the chicken into a shallow roasting pan and roast for about 35 minutes, turning now and then, until cooked through and glossy.

title: Stovetop Eggplant With Harissa, Chickpeas, and Cumin Yogurt
steps: Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over high heat until shimmering. Add the small whole eggplants and lower the heat to medium.
Season them and turn them often until browned on all sides and a fork goes in easily, about 20 minutes. Sprinkle in a little water if they start to burn.

Mix the harissa with the drained chickpeas and the tomatoes, add them to the pan and cook for about 5 minutes, until the tomatoes blister and break down. Season and add a little water to make it saucy.
Meanwhile, mix the yogurt with the cumin and season.
Top the eggplant with parsley and a drizzle of olive oil, and serve with the yogurt.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Quinoa and Black Beans
steps: Cook the quinoa as the package says. Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Halve the peppers, seed them and bake them cut side up in the dish for 15 to 20 minutes, until slightly soft.
Meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the chopped onion for 3 to 4 minutes, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Stir in the quinoa, drained beans, corn, tomatoes, cumin, chili powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper and cook for 5 to 7 minutes. Take it off the heat and stir in 1 cup of the cheese.
Fill the peppers, top with the rest of the cheese and bake for 15 to 20 minutes more, until the cheese melts. Let them cool for 5 minutes and scatter with cilantro.

title: Stuffed Lamb Tomatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Slice the tops off the tomatoes and keep them. Scoop out most of the pulp, chop it and keep the juice. Sprinkle the insides with a little sugar and put the tomatoes on a baking sheet.
Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan and cook the chopped onion and garlic gently for about 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the lamb, cinnamon and tomato paste, turn up the heat and fry until browned. Add the tomato pulp and juice, the rice and the broth, and season well.
Bring to a boil and simmer for about 15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed. Let it cool a little and stir in the herbs.
Fill the tomatoes to the top, put the lids on, drizzle with the rest of the oil, sprinkle 3 tbsp of water into the pan and bake for 35 minutes. Serve hot or cold.

title: Sukuma Wiki
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the sliced onions for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring now and then, until soft.
Add the shredded kale, mix well, lower the heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 5 minutes.
Uncover, add salt to taste and stir in the cream. Cook for 5 minutes more, stirring now and then, until slightly thick. Serve with a stew and ugali.

title: Summer Pistou
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the sliced leeks and diced zucchini for 5 minutes to soften.
Pour in the broth and add three quarters of the drained beans, the chopped green beans and half of the chopped tomatoes. Simmer for 5 to 8 minutes, until tender.
Meanwhile, blend the rest of the beans and tomatoes with the garlic and basil until smooth, then stir in the parmesan.
Stir this sauce into the soup, cook for 1 minute and serve.

title: Sweet potato salad
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the sweet potato chunks with the oil and some seasoning and spread them on a lined baking sheet.
Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, until tender and golden. Let them cool.
Whisk the finely chopped shallots, sliced green onions, chopped chives, vinegar and honey with a little salt and pepper.
Gently toss the dressing through the sweet potatoes with your hands, so they don't break up.

title: Syrian Spaghetti
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish.
Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of lightly salted boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, until al dente, and drain.
Stir in the tomato sauce, tomato paste, cinnamon, oil, salt and pepper and spread it in the dish.
Bake for about 1 hour, until the top is crunchy.

title: Tafelspitz
steps: Cut the unpeeled onion in half and brown the cut sides well in a dry pan.
Put about 12 cups (3 liters) of water in a large pot with the chopped carrots, celeriac and parsnips, the leek, the onion halves, parsley, bay leaves and peppercorns, and bring to a boil.
Add the beef and simmer very gently for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, until tender, skimming off any foam and adding water as needed. Season with salt only after 2 hours.
Lift out the beef and keep it warm in a little of the broth. Season and strain the rest of the broth and serve it as a starter.
Slice the beef across the grain and serve it with roast potatoes and horseradish.

title: Tahini Lentils
steps: Mix the tahini with the zest and juice of the lemon and 3 1/2 tbsp (50 ml) of cold water into a runny dressing. Season.
Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat and fry the sliced onion with a pinch of salt for 2 minutes.
Add the garlic, sliced pepper, green beans and zucchini and fry for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add the kale, cooked lentils and the dressing and stir for a couple of minutes, until the kale wilts and everything is coated.

title: Tamiya
steps: Soak the dried skinless broad beans in water overnight. Drain them and pat them dry.
Grind them in a food processor into a paste, without making it too smooth, or the patties fall apart.
Mix in the green onions, garlic, parsley, cumin, baking powder, cayenne and some salt and pepper. Chill for at least 30 minutes.
Shape the mixture into 1-inch balls, flatten them slightly and coat them in flour.
Heat at least 1 1/2 inches of oil to 365°F (185°C) and fry the patties in batches for about 5 minutes, turning once, until golden. Serve hot with a salad.

title: Tandoori chicken
steps: Mix the lemon juice with the paprika and the sliced red onions in a large shallow dish. Slash each chicken thigh three times, turn them in the juice and set aside for 10 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the grated ginger, crushed garlic, garam masala, cumin, chili powder and turmeric, pour it over the chicken and mix well. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour, or up to a day.
Heat the broiler. Lift the chicken onto a rack over a baking sheet, brush with a little oil and broil for about 8 minutes on each side, until charred in places and cooked through.

title: Tangy cabbage slaw
steps: Whisk the mayonnaise, lemon zest and juice, vinegar, mustard and celery salt together and season well.
Add the shredded cabbages, grated carrots, thinly sliced onion and sliced celery and mix well.
Chill until serving. It keeps for up to 1 day.

title: Tangy carrot, cabbage & onion salad
steps: Put the grated carrots, shredded cabbage and thinly sliced onions in a bowl.
Stir the lime juice, peanut oil, chopped chili and sugar together until the sugar dissolves.
Pour it over the vegetables and toss. Add the herbs, toss again and scatter with the chopped peanuts.

title: Tavë Kosi Baked Lamb and Yogurt
steps: Melt half of the butter with the olive oil in a large pan with a lid and brown the diced lamb over medium heat for about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, 1 tsp of the oregano and 1 1/4 cups (300 ml) of the water, season, cover and simmer for 50 minutes, stirring a couple of times.
Add the rest of the water and the rice, bring to a boil, cover and cook for about 10 minutes, until the liquid has almost gone. Spread it in a baking dish with at least 2 inches of room on top.
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Melt the rest of the butter in a small pan and stir in the flour for 2 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with the eggs and some salt and pepper, then quickly whisk in the flour mixture. Pour it over the lamb and sprinkle with the rest of the oregano.
Bake on the bottom shelf for 35 minutes, then on the middle shelf for 10 minutes more, until risen with a golden crust. Let it cool for 5 to 10 minutes.

title: Tavë me Presh ska Mish Meatless Leek Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Fry the sliced leeks in a little olive oil for a few minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the roasted, sliced peppers, garlic, broth, herbs, salt, pepper and paprika, stir, then add the rice.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Pour into a baking dish at least 2 inches deep and spread it out evenly.
Bake on the bottom shelf for 1 hour. Let it cool for 10 minutes in the oven with the door open before serving.

title: Teriyaki Chicken Casserole
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan. Cook the brown rice if it isn't cooked.
Bring the soy sauce, 1/2 cup of water, brown sugar, ginger and garlic to a boil in a small covered saucepan, then uncover and cook for 1 minute.
Mix the cornstarch with 2 tbsp of water, stir it into the sauce and cook until it starts to thicken.
Put the chicken in the pan, pour 1 cup of the sauce over it and bake for about 35 minutes, until cooked through. Shred it in the pan with two forks.

Meanwhile, steam the vegetables. Add them and the rice to the chicken with most of the rest of the sauce, toss and bake for 15 minutes more. Let it stand for 5 minutes and drizzle with the last of the sauce.

title: Thai coconut & veg broth
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil in a large saucepan or wok for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the broth, coconut milk and sugar and simmer for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles, sliced carrots and shredded cabbage and simmer for 4 to 6 minutes, until tender.
Stir in the bean sprouts and halved tomatoes, add lime juice and seasoning to taste, and serve sprinkled with green onions and cilantro.

title: Thai curry noodle soup
steps: Heat the oil in a saucepan over medium heat and cook the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the vegetables and shrimp and cook for 3 minutes, until the shrimp are mostly pink.
Add the coconut milk, broth and noodles, bring to a boil, then simmer for 5 minutes, until the noodles are cooked and the vegetables still have a bite.
Divide between 2 bowls and sprinkle with the herbs, sliced chili and green onion.

title: Thai pork & peanut curry
steps: Heat the oil in a large saucepan and cook the sliced green onions and chopped cilantro stalks for 1 minute. Add the sliced pork and cook for 5 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Stir in the curry paste and peanut butter for 30 seconds, then add the sugar, soy sauce, coconut milk and 3/4 cup of water.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Uncover, add the corn and turn up the heat. Bubble for 3 minutes, until the sauce thickens a little. Stir in the lime juice, season and serve with the cilantro leaves and rice.

title: Thai prawn curry
steps: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan and cook the chopped onion and ginger for a few minutes, until soft.
Stir in the curry paste for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and coconut cream.
Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes, adding a little boiling water if it gets too thick.
Add the shrimp and cook for 5 to 10 minutes, depending on their size. Serve with rice and chopped cilantro.

title: Thai pumpkin soup
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the pumpkin chunks in a roasting pan with half of the oil and some seasoning and roast for 30 minutes, until golden and tender.
Meanwhile, gently cook the chopped onion, ginger and bruised lemongrass in the rest of the oil for 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in the curry paste for 1 minute, then the roasted pumpkin, all but 3 tbsp of the coconut milk and the broth. Simmer for 5 minutes and remove the lemongrass.
Blend until smooth and reheat, seasoning with salt, pepper, lime juice and a pinch of sugar if needed.
Serve drizzled with the rest of the coconut milk and sprinkled with sliced chili.

title: Three-cheese souffles
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) and butter 4 small ramekins. Coat the insides with the parmesan. Bring the milk and bay leaves to a boil, turn off the heat and leave for 15 minutes.
Remove the bay leaves, add the butter and flour and whisk over low heat for about 6 minutes, until you have a smooth, thick sauce.
Move it to a large bowl and stir in the mustard, a pinch of cayenne, the grated Gruyère and the egg yolks.
Whisk the egg whites in a very clean bowl until soft peaks form, and gently fold them into the sauce in three parts. Fill the ramekins.
Top each with a slice of goat cheese and bake on a baking sheet for 20 to 25 minutes, until risen.
For a second bake, turn them out upside down into a baking dish, top with the rest of the goat cheese, pour the cream over them and bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden. Serve with a salad.

title: Tirolean Dumplings
steps: Finely chop the shallots and dice the ham. Cook the shallots in a little butter until translucent, add the ham and parsley, fry briefly and take it off the heat.
Cut the bread into cubes and put it in a bowl. Beat the milk with the eggs, salt, pepper and nutmeg and pour it over the bread.
Stir in the ham mixture and the flour into a fairly firm dough, adding more bread or flour if needed. Smooth the top and leave it for about 30 minutes.
Bring a large pan of salted water to a boil. With wet hands, shape the dough into dumplings, small or medium-sized.
Drop them into the boiling water, bring back to a boil and simmer gently for 8 to 20 minutes, depending on size. Drain and serve with chopped parsley and browned butter.

title: Toad In The Hole
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Brown the sausages in a non-stick pan.
Pour the oil into a 12 x 10-inch roasting pan, about 2 inches deep, and heat it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Put the flour in a bowl, crack in the eggs and stir in the horseradish. Gradually beat in the milk and season.
Put the sausages in the hot pan, pour the batter over them and top with the tomatoes. Bake for 30 minutes, until puffed and golden.

title: Tofu, greens & cashew stir-fry
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick wok and fry the broccoli florets over high heat for about 5 minutes, until just tender, adding a little water if it catches.
Add the sliced garlic and chili for 1 minute.
Toss in the sliced green onions, the soybeans, the bok choy and the cubed tofu and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes.
Add the hoisin sauce, soy sauce and cashews and toss until hot.

title: Tom yum (hot & sour) soup with prawns
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Add the bruised lemongrass, the galangal, the cilantro stalks and roots and the lime leaves and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the shrimp, fish sauce, chilies and lime juice and bring back to a boil.
Taste and add more lime juice or fish sauce if needed. Serve garnished with cilantro leaves.

title: Tonkatsu pork
steps: Trim the large strip of fat from each chop, then pound them between two sheets of parchment to about 1/2 inch (1 cm) thick and push them back into shape.
Put the flour, beaten eggs and breadcrumbs in three wide bowls. Season the pork and coat it in flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Heat about 3/4 inch of oil in a large frying pan to 350°F (180°C), or until a breadcrumb sinks slightly and then sizzles.
Fry 2 chops at a time for 1 1/2 minutes on each side, then rest them on a rack for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, whisk the ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, oyster sauce and sugar into a sauce, adding a splash of water if it's thick. Slice the pork and drizzle with the sauce.

title: Torta de fiambre
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line the bottom of an 8 to 9-inch springform pan with parchment, leaving some overhang. Grate the cheese.
Whisk the eggs, oil, milk, flour, baking powder, salt and a pinch of oregano for 1 to 2 minutes into a very runny batter.
Pour in half of the batter, lay the ham and cheese on top and pour over the rest.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until golden on top. Let it rest for a few minutes before unmolding. Serve hot or cold.

title: Tortang Talong
steps: Grill the eggplants over a gas flame or on a hot grill pan until the skins are almost black.
Let them cool a little and peel off the skin, keeping the stems on.
Beat the eggs with the salt in a wide bowl.
Flatten each eggplant on a board with a fork and dip it in the egg.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the eggplants for 3 to 4 minutes on each side, until the egg is cooked.

title: Trinxat (Potato, Cabbage and Bacon Hash)
steps: Boil the chopped cabbage and potatoes in salted water for 30 to 40 minutes, until tender. Drain very well, return them to the pot over low heat and let them steam dry.
Meanwhile, fry the bacon until crisp, keeping the fat, and chop it into small pieces.
Mash the potatoes and cabbage with the minced garlic and season.
Press the mash into a skillet with the bacon and the bacon fat and fry until golden brown underneath. Flip it and brown the other side.
Cut into servings and garnish with chopped parsley.

title: Tuna and Egg Briks
steps: Heat 2 tsp of the oil in a large saucepan and cook the sliced green onions over low heat for 3 minutes. Add the spinach, cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until wilted. Drain and let it cool.
Cut 24 rounds about 5 inches (12.5 cm) wide from the filo, 6 from each sheet, and keep them covered.
Squeeze the spinach dry and mix it with the drained tuna, the beaten eggs, hot sauce, salt and pepper.

Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Stack 3 filo rounds, brushing each lightly with oil. Put a heaped tablespoon of filling in the middle, fold into a half-moon and twist the edges to seal. Make 8 in all.
Brush them with the rest of the oil and bake on a non-stick sheet for 12 to 15 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Mix the diced tomatoes and cucumber with the lemon juice and seasoning, and serve with the briks and the apricot jam.

title: Tuna Nicoise
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Toss the potatoes with 2 tsp of the olive oil and some seasoning and roast them on a large baking sheet for 20 minutes, stirring halfway, until crisp and cooked.
Meanwhile, put the eggs in a small pan of water, bring to a boil and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool them in cold water, peel and halve them.
In a large salad bowl, whisk the rest of the oils with the vinegar and capers and season.
Add the thinly sliced onion, the spinach, the drained tuna and the potatoes and toss gently. Top with the eggs and serve right away.

title: Tunisian Lamb Soup
steps: Brown the lamb in a casserole over high heat. Set it aside and pour off all but 1 tbsp of the fat.
Lower the heat to medium and cook the garlic, chopped onion and spinach for about 5 minutes, until the onion is translucent and the spinach wilted.
Return the lamb and add the tomato paste, cumin, harissa, broth, drained chickpeas, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Simmer over low heat for about 20 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook for about 15 minutes, until tender.

title: Turkey Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the chopped onion for 8 to 10 minutes, until soft. Stir in the garlic, Worcestershire sauce and 2 tsp of the tomato paste and let it cool.
Mix the turkey, egg, breadcrumbs and onion mixture well and season. Shape it into a rectangular loaf in a large roasting pan.
Spread 1 tbsp of the barbecue sauce over the top and bake for 30 minutes.
Meanwhile, drain one can of beans only and mix both cans with the rest of the barbecue sauce and tomato paste. Season.
Spoon the beans around the meatloaf and bake for 15 minutes more, until it's cooked through and the beans are hot. Scatter with parsley and serve in slices.

title: Turkish lahmacun
steps: Put the flour in a large bowl, make a well in the middle and sprinkle in the yeast. Pour 1/2 cup (125 ml) of water over the yeast, cover it with a little of the flour and leave it in a warm place for 15 minutes, until the surface cracks.
Mix in 1 cup (250 ml) more water and 1 tsp of salt and knead for about 10 minutes, until elastic. Cover and let it rise for 30 minutes, until doubled.
Heat the oven as high as it goes (about 475°F/240°C) and sprinkle baking sheets with cornmeal.
Peel, seed and chop the tomatoes and finely dice the seeded chilies. Mix them with the green onions, half of the parsley (finely chopped), the beef, the spices, 1 tsp of salt and 1/2 tsp of pepper.
Divide the dough into 4 balls, roll each into a thin circle and spread with a thin layer of the meat.
Bake each for 10 to 15 minutes, until the edges darken. Top with the rest of the parsley, the sliced red onion and a squeeze of lemon, and serve right away.

title: Vegan banh mi
steps: Toss the shredded vegetables with the vinegar, sugar and 1 tsp of salt and let them pickle while you make the rest.
Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Cut the baguette into 4 pieces and slice each in half lengthwise. Warm them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Spread each piece with hummus. Top 4 of them with slices of tempeh and the pickled vegetables.
Sprinkle with the herbs and some hot sauce and close the sandwiches.

title: Vegan Lasagna
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Boil the diced carrot, onion and zucchini for 5 to 7 minutes, until soft. Add the lentils and simmer for about 20 minutes, stirring, until soft. Stir in some chopped cilantro.
Blanch the spinach for a minute or two and set it aside. Cook the lasagne sheets in the same pan, then drain them.
For the sauce, melt the vegan butter, stir in the flour, then gradually whisk in the soy milk with the mustard and vinegar. Cook, stirring, until smooth and thick.
Layer the lentils, spinach, lasagne sheets and sauce in a baking dish, finishing with sauce.
Bake for about 25 minutes.

title: Vegetable Shepherds Pie
steps: Heat the oven to 450°F (230°C). Bake the potatoes on a lined sheet for about 45 minutes, until tender. Peel them, press them through a ricer and stir in the butter, then the milk. Season.

Soak the dried mushrooms in 3 cups of hot water. Simmer the lentils with 1 garlic clove, 1 tsp of salt and 4 cups of water for 15 to 20 minutes, until tender but not mushy. Drain and discard the garlic.
Heat 3 tbsp of oil in a large heavy pot and cook the onions for about 12 minutes, until soft. Add the chopped garlic for 1 minute, then the tomato paste for 2 to 3 minutes, until caramelized.

Add the bay leaves and wine and scrape the pan. Add the mushrooms and pour in their liquid, leaving the grit behind. Simmer until reduced by half, about 10 minutes, then add the broth and reduce by half again, about 45 minutes.
Strain the sauce into a saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp of water and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick. Stir in the soy sauce and season.

Toss the chopped vegetables with 2 tbsp of oil, the rosemary, salt and pepper, and roast on 2 sheets for 20 to 25 minutes. Spread the lentils in a 3-quart baking dish, top with the vegetables and chopped herbs, pour the sauce over and cover with the potatoes. Bake for about 30 minutes and let it stand for 15 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Casserole
steps: Heat the oil in a large heavy pan and cook the chopped onion gently for 5 to 10 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, paprika, cumin, dried thyme and the chopped carrots, celery and peppers and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, broth, sliced zucchini and thyme sprigs and cook for 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove the thyme sprigs, stir in the cooked lentils and bring back to a simmer. Serve with rice, mash or quinoa.

title: Vegetarian Chilli
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cook the roasted vegetables in a casserole dish for 15 minutes.
Add the drained beans and the tomatoes, season and cook for 10 to 15 minutes more, until piping hot.
Heat the grain pouch in the microwave for 1 minute and serve with the chili.

title: Venezuelan Arepas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (210°C). Dissolve the salt in the room-temperature water in a large bowl.
Slowly add the precooked cornmeal while you stir, until smooth. Let the dough rest for 5 minutes. It should be firm but easy to shape.
Heat a griddle or non-stick pan over medium heat and oil it lightly.
With wet hands, shape about 2 tablespoons of dough into a ball, then flatten it into a disc about 3/4 inch thick and 4 inches wide, smoothing any cracks.
Cook the arepas in batches for 4 to 5 minutes on each side, until golden.
Bake them on a baking sheet for 10 minutes, until slightly puffy and they sound hollow when tapped. Serve hot, plain or filled.

title: Venezuelan Coconut Chicken
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces, slice the onions and mince the garlic.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the onions until translucent. Put them in a blender.
Add the tomatoes, garlic, turmeric, cumin, sugar, ginger paste, coconut milk and water and blend until smooth.
Brown the chicken on all sides in the same pan, about 3 minutes.
Add the blended sauce and the bay leaves, bring to a simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes, until the chicken is cooked and the sauce creamy. Remove the bay leaves, season and serve with white rice.

title: Venezuelan Sancocho
steps: Put the beef shank, half an onion, the half bell pepper, 4 whole garlic cloves, the dark green leek leaves and the broth in a large pot. Simmer for 45 to 60 minutes, until the meat is fork-tender.
Lift out and discard the large vegetable pieces and the bones.

Add the rest of the onion, diced, 2 minced garlic cloves, the chopped red pepper, the sliced light green leek, the green onions, the cassava and the corn, cut into rounds. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes, until the cassava starts to soften.
Add the yautia, yam and squash, cut into chunks, and simmer covered for 5 to 6 minutes, until tender. Don't overcook them, or they fall apart.
Season with salt, add chopped cilantro and the last 2 garlic cloves, minced, and simmer for 2 minutes. Serve in large bowls with lime or hot sauce.

title: Vietnamese caramel trout
steps: Cook the rice. Put the sugar in a large shallow pan with a small splash of water and heat gently, swirling, until it dissolves.
Turn up the heat and bubble the syrup until it's dark amber. Add the fish sauce, most of the sliced chili and ginger and 1 tbsp of water, and boil again until syrupy.
Add the fish skin side down and the halved bok choy cut side down. Cover and simmer for 4 to 5 minutes, until the fish is cooked and the bok choy has wilted.
Turn off the heat, squeeze over the lemon and scatter with the rest of the chili and ginger and the cilantro. Serve with rice.

title: Vietnamese chicken salad
steps: Whisk the lime juice, fish sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil and chopped chili into a dressing in a large serving bowl.
Cook the noodles as the package says, drain them and add them to the dressing.
Peel the carrot into long ribbons with a vegetable peeler, and the cucumber too, stopping at the seeds.
Add the carrot and cucumber to the noodles with the cooked, shredded chicken, the sliced radishes and red onion and the mint leaves. Toss well and scatter with the peanuts.

title: Vietnamese Grilled Pork (bun-thit-nuong)
steps: Slice the pork very thinly, about 1/8 inch. It's easier if you freeze it for a little while first.
Mix the minced garlic and shallots with the sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, pepper and oil until the sugar dissolves. Marinate the pork in it for 1 hour, or overnight.
Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake the pork for 10 to 15 minutes, until almost cooked, then broil it until golden, turning halfway. Bake the egg rolls as the package says.
Meanwhile, cook the noodles as the package says and rinse them in cold water.
Fill bowls with the noodles, the pork, the sliced egg rolls, cucumber, mint and crushed peanuts.

title: Vietnamese lamb shanks with sweet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F (160°C). Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a heavy casserole, season the shanks and brown them 2 at a time on all sides, adding the rest of the oil for the second batch. Set them aside.
Fry the sliced onions briskly for 30 seconds, add the grated ginger, garlic and 1 chopped chili, lower the heat and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in 2 tsp of the sugar, then add the star anise, bruised lemongrass, stock, tomato paste and seasoning. Return the lamb and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook in the oven for 1 1/2 hours, then add the sweet potatoes, cut into chunks, and cook for 1 hour more, until the lamb is almost falling off the bone.
Stir in the fish sauce, the lime juice and the rest of the sugar. Scatter with the mint, basil and the other chili, sliced.

title: Vietnamese-style veggie hotpot
steps: Heat the oil in a medium saucepan with a lid and stir-fry the shredded ginger and sliced garlic for about 5 minutes.
Add the squash, cut into chunks, the soy sauce, sugar and broth. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes.
Uncover, add the green beans and cook for 3 minutes more, until the squash and beans are tender.
Stir in the sliced green onions at the last minute, sprinkle with cilantro and serve with rice.

title: Warm roast asparagus salad
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Snap off the woody ends of the asparagus and lay it in a single layer in a baking pan with sides.
Halve the tomatoes and nestle them among the asparagus, season and drizzle with some of the olive oil. Roll up each bacon slice tightly and add it to the pan.
Drizzle the bacon with the honey and bake for 20 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft and the bacon crisp.
Meanwhile, boil the potatoes until tender. Whisk the vinegar, the rest of the oil, the mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Toss the arugula in half of the dressing and spread it on a platter. Halve the potatoes, toss them in the rest of the dressing and arrange them with the asparagus, tomatoes and bacon.

title: Wontons
steps: Mix the ground pork with the minced garlic and ginger, the soy sauce, sesame oil and the finely chopped carrots, celery and green onions.
Separate the wonton wrappers. Put a heaped teaspoon of filling in the middle of each.
Brush water along 2 edges, fold the wrapper into a triangle and press to seal. Pinch the two long points together.
Heat oil for deep-frying to 375°F (190°C) and fry 4 or 5 at a time until golden. Drain and serve with a dipping sauce.

title: Yemeni Lahsa (Elite Shakshuka)
steps: Heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the diced onion until it softens.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, then the allspice, a pinch of salt and the pepper.
Add the beaten eggs and stir for 2 minutes, then cover and cook for 5 to 6 minutes, until the top sets.
Spread the cheese over the top, cover for 1 minute more and serve.

title: Zapiekanki
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Bake the baguettes on a baking sheet for 8 to 10 minutes and let them cool.

Heat 2 tsp of the butter and 1 tsp of the oil in a pan over low heat and cook half of the onion, chopped, for 5 minutes. Add the sliced mushrooms, turn the heat to medium and cook for 5 to 10 minutes, until the liquid has gone. Add the garlic for 1 to 2 minutes, season and stir in the mayonnaise.
Halve the baguettes lengthwise, spread them with the mushroom mixture and sprinkle with the cheddar, ham, sliced sausage and mozzarella. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden.
Meanwhile, fry the rest of the onion, sliced, in the rest of the butter and oil for 5 minutes, until golden.
Top the baguettes with the onions, sliced pickles, chives and a drizzle of ketchup.

title: Zemiakové Placky
steps: Peel and finely grate the potatoes, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can in a clean towel.
Mix them with the finely chopped onion, the minced garlic, eggs, flour, marjoram, salt and pepper into a thick batter.
Heat plenty of oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Spoon in portions of batter and flatten them into thin pancakes. Fry until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
